boss-23a6fbb0.text: On behalf of the board: thank you. The sky is now a product. And you, Asset, are now a cost.

boss-61dad763.text: I wanted to thank you personally. You built the cannon on time, under budget, and you never once asked what it was for. That kind of loyalty deserves a reward. Unfortunately, rewards were discontinued in Q3.

boss-6ba0e025.text: A blackout. How refreshing. Darkness is our most popular product next quarter. Please don't give it away for free.

boss-8d72423e.text: Memo from the desk of Nolan Isaac Locke: smiling is now billable. Please smile responsibly.

boss-a7933a38.text: Good evening, Asset. Nolan Isaac Locke, Chief Executive of NIHIL.

boss-d0d9aec0.text: Nolan here. The board is watching your progress with great interest, and a small amount of popcorn. Carry on.

delta-03812106.text: A Foundry (key 5) takes iron ingots on one side and coal on another. Coal is the ringed black crystal field.

delta-0428e642.text: NILE will also send you Priority Requests from now on. Completing them pays a bonus. Ignoring them is noted in your file.

delta-05bf06f3.text: Oh, a small update: the Moon's impact date has been revised from 'seventeen days' to 'soon'. Please do not request clarification.

delta-0d2b14f5.text: Welcome back, Asset. Your absence has been logged, timestamped and gently judged.

delta-0d47029f.text: Research points! Spend them in the Research panel. Knowledge is power, and power is billed by the kilowatt.

delta-0d9dd8c1.text: NILE has also acquired the forest edge. The trees were not consulted. The fence has moved again.

delta-1085d0a7.text: Your contract has concluded. NIHIL thanks you for your service. Please return your helmet, your boots and your sense of purpose.

delta-156a5bea.text: Fun fact: the Dispatch Pad has been Employee of the Month fourteen months in a row. You have been rated "adequate".

delta-165057fb.text: Set an Assembler to Motor: steel, an iron plate and copper wire, each from its own side.

delta-17754df2.text: Good news: NILE has acquired the neighbouring farmland. The farmer was very understanding. Your plot has grown.

delta-1b6b8029.text: A Splitter (key T) sends one belt three ways. A Merger (key Y) does the opposite. Like a family, but useful.

delta-1f44769a.text: Before you get ideas: your contract requires completion. Clause 88 also requires you to enjoy it. Please smile at the nearest camera.

delta-23945bbc.text: Fun fact: NILE stands for Network for Infrastructure, Logistics & Engineering. The E is for Engineering. And for Everyone. Mostly Engineering.

delta-242ea07b.text: See the orange arrow on it? That is where a machine sends things out; teal arrows are where it takes things in. Press R to rotate before placing; the ghost shows its arrows too. Now build a Smelter (key 3) a couple of tiles away, in line with that orange arrow.

delta-2ceb0f6b.text: Low on credits? Erasing a building (right-click) refunds its full cost. NILE calls it "flexible capital".

delta-3142e01e.text: Belt the ingots into the Dispatch Pad, the landing pad with the arrow hovering over it. Everything you deliver goes straight into Protocol: Selene, the construction site right next to it, and NILE pays you per delivery. Generously-ish.

delta-338b5be0.text: The whole valley is yours to build on now. Well, NILE's. You may borrow it. Mind the river: it belongs to the fish until further notice.

delta-3a69d04c.text: An Advanced Circuit. It contains forty thousand transistors and one tiny NILE logo you will never be able to remove.

delta-3dcbcd2d.text: Final phase: Ignition. Let's finish this, Asset. For Earth. Well. For the shareholders on Earth.

delta-400775c8.text: An Assembler (key 6) makes a Circuit from one iron plate and one copper wire. Two presses, one assembler, a great many belts.

delta-422b68f0.text: Lower the load first: switch machines off in their panels, or build and fuel more Generators. Then press Reset on the power gauge. Reset too early and it trips again.

delta-42b2d463.text: Select Belt (key 1) and drag from just after the Extractor's arrow into the Smelter. Items follow the arrows.

delta-44998a68.text: NIHIL reminds you: nothing lasts forever. Except your contract.

delta-46dea570.text: The Smelter is key 3. Put it a couple of tiles from the Extractor, on the side its arrow points to.

delta-479569e3.text: Phase 4 is the Payload: Motors and Advanced Circuits. A Motor takes steel, a plate and a wire, one on each side of an Assembler. Advanced Circuits need research first.

delta-4896d7ea.text: A circuit! So small. So fragile. So billable.

delta-509ab6c1.text: Now connect them. Select Belt (key 1) and drag from the Extractor's orange arrow to one of the Smelter's teal ones. Belts follow your mouse, corners included. An arrow lights up once something is hooked up to it.

delta-517bc040.text: NIHIL thanks you for your continued compliance.

delta-52d3cd55.text: The Dispatch Pad is the ringed landing pad with the arrow hovering over it. Drag a belt from the Smelter's output into it.

delta-55f08a50.text: Let's start small. I've ringed the grey crystals near the Dispatch Pad: that's iron ore. Select the Extractor (key 2) and place it on one.

delta-57fa1743.text: Deadline missed. Don't worry, it has only been added to your permanent record.

delta-59646d36.text: An Assembler (key 6) needs one iron plate AND one copper wire. Belt both into it, any side works.

delta-5a8a0637.text: Belt Data Cartridges from the Fabricator into a Lab (key 8). The Lab turns them into points.

delta-5c6e7d3e.text: Click an Assembler and pick Advanced Circuit, then feed it 2 circuits + 1 steel.

delta-63fd0850.text: Generator is key 0. Split your coal belt: some for the Foundry, some for the Generator.

delta-7248e780.text: A Selene Shell is one steel, one explosive and one advanced circuit. Fifteen shells and seventy-five capacitors, and the cannon fires.

delta-74a2736f.text: NILE has a plan. It's called Protocol: Selene, a cannon powerful enough to push the Moon back into a safe orbit. And you are going to build it.

delta-74d07666.text: Copper ore is the ringed orange crystal field: an Extractor on it, a belt, and a Smelter set to Copper Ingot.

delta-78d4ed23.text: Push it much further and the breaker trips. Generators arrive after Phase 2. Until then: switch machines off in their panels, or enjoy the slow life.

delta-7c1cc24c.text: Generator online. Coal in, electricity out, guilt not included.

delta-8001a8ed.text: Out of eight billion candidates, NILE chose you. Your courage, your talent and your remarkably low salary expectations made it an easy decision.

delta-831b30a2.text: Reminder: NILE values your wellbeing. Wellbeing breaks are available in fifteen-second increments.

delta-8977ecb2.text: An iron ingot! Humanity's odds of survival just rose by 0.0001 percent.

delta-8df185a5.text: Firing in three... two... I'm contractually obliged to say 'one'.

delta-9077c312.text: You need plates for the Pad and for circuits. A Splitter (key T) sends one belt three ways.

delta-90f4b798.text: Tidy-up tip: press V and drag a box round some machines. G moves them, C copies them, X demolishes them, and R turns them while you carry them. F picks up whatever is under your cursor.

delta-91091d36.text: Hello, Steward! I'm DELTA, your Dispatch & Engineering Logistics Task Assistant. I'll be with you every step of the way. That part is not optional.

delta-915bcae6.text: The river has been reclassified as a resource. NIHIL dammed it overnight; the yellow crystals in its dry bed are sulfur. The Mixer (key 9) turns sulfur and coal into Explosives.

delta-9167c3fd.text: Feed a Fabricator (key 7) circuits and copper wire.

delta-92b94dcf.text: Advanced Circuits cost 60 research points in the Research panel.

delta-944fc669.text: Request complete, bonus credited. NILE appreciates your hustle. NILE also monetises your hustle.

delta-98bd774d.text: Set an Assembler to Capacitor and feed it steel and copper wire.

delta-9d054279.text: Also, HR has updated your title. You are no longer a Steward. You are an Asset. Congratulations on the promotion.

delta-a07baaff.text: Moving on! Phase 3 is the Power Core: Steel and Capacitors. A Capacitor is one steel and two copper wire, in an Assembler. Faster work is its own reward. It is also the only reward.

delta-a4176028.text: Welcome back, Steward. Your absence has been logged, timestamped and gently judged.

delta-a46badaf.text: Research is open! The Fabricator (key 7) turns a circuit and a copper wire into a Data Cartridge. The Lab (key 8) reads cartridges into research points.

delta-a7f2e963.text: Moon+ beta testers report "a deep sense of loss" and "surprisingly reasonable pricing".

delta-a83d6fec.text: Quick orientation: WASD or the arrow keys move your view, the mouse wheel zooms, Q and E rotate. Middle-drag works too.

delta-acefbf9d.text: Select the Extractor (key 2) and click one of the ringed grey crystals. Extractors only work on ore.

delta-acf46474.text: Today's motto: ex nihilo, nihil fit. Nothing comes from nothing, so please keep producing.

delta-afb919f7.text: Rebranding update: all uniforms now read NIHIL. Yours will be deducted from your salary.

delta-b1d0aff2.text: Brownout detected. Build Generators and keep them fed with coal. Darkness is a premium feature.

delta-b3d21609.text: Productivity tip: belts move items faster than worrying does.

delta-b4d8c423.text: Heavy industry, at last! The Foundry (key 5) melts an iron ingot and a lump of coal into Steel.

delta-b8a1ecbe.text: The sulfur lies in the dry river bed, in the south-west corner. Put an Extractor on the ringed yellow crystals.

delta-b9d75f34.text: Click a Smelter to open its panel and pick Copper Ingot. A Smelter only takes the ore of its recipe.

delta-bac53c7d.text: Put a Press (key 4) after an iron Smelter. A new Press starts on Iron Plate.

delta-bb472ffb.text: Delivery confirmed! Credits added to your account, minus processing fees, minus the fee for calculating processing fees.

delta-c049b6ab.text: The Moon is still falling. Probably. Please keep working.

delta-c0c4df55.text: A Mixer (key 9) takes sulfur on one side and coal on another.

delta-c7677bb6.text: A factory that makes many things earns more than one that makes one thing a lot. Priority Requests still pay their bonus in full. NILE calls this "healthy competition with yourself".

delta-c8b93c96.text: Congratulations, Asset. You have saved Earth from free things.

delta-c94a5010.text: Breaker tripped! The grid was overloaded, so everything electric has stopped. Very safe. Very quiet.

delta-ca8c5a30.text: Tides will be discontinued shortly. Beachfront property owners have been notified via a pop-up ad.

delta-cb24d78a.text: Foundries are hungry. Generators (key 0) burn coal for the grid: belt coal from the black crystal field into one. You will want several.

delta-cf91483e.text: Market saturation! The Pad pays less for whatever you flood it with. Prices recover over time.

delta-d135d851.text: Priority Request missed. The customer has been compensated with a coupon for a different customer.

delta-d4dee17a.text: Phase 1 needs 40 iron ingots and 20 copper ingots. Copper is the glowing orange crystal field; I've ringed it. The Moon won't un-fall itself.

delta-d5679cd0.text: The Moon is a free night light. Free things undercut Moon+. And so, the Moon has to go.

delta-d6fc0db1.text: Click any machine to open its panel: its recipe, how fast it works and its upgrades. Every machine makes one thing. A new Smelter starts on iron, so set your copper Smelter to Copper Ingot.

delta-d85a839b.text: Beautiful. Your very first Extractor. NILE Legal has already trademarked it.

delta-de363074.text: ...NILE. I said NILE. You heard NILE. Everyone heard NILE.

delta-dee9115a.text: Customer survey: on a scale of 1 to 5, how saved does Earth feel? Answers below 5 will be reviewed by HR.

delta-e1263c6f.text: Click a machine and press Upgrade in its panel (or use the Upgrade tool, key U). Higher tiers work faster. The Moon will not wait. Well, it will. But NIHIL will not.

delta-e3c822cc.text: Full transparency, as required by absolutely no regulation: the Moon was never falling.

delta-e4644b08.text: Look at you go! I've unlocked the Press, the Assembler, the Splitter and the Merger.

delta-e75a7bd9.text: Put a second Press after your copper Smelter, click it and pick Copper Wire.

delta-e8acce4d.text: Priority Request fulfilled. Somewhere, a customer received a moon-shaped lamp. The irony is lost on them.

delta-e8d2d26d.text: Brownout! You have more machines than the starter grid can feed. They keep working, just slower. Like interns.

delta-e9414417.text: Please disregard that memo. It was sent to you by mistake. You are not cleared for mistakes.

delta-efaf589b.text: NILE's mission statement has been shortened for efficiency. It is now one word. The word is pending.

delta-efbc75dc.text: Phase 2 needs targeting circuitry: Iron Plates and Circuits. The Press (key 4) stamps iron ingots into plates, or draws copper ingots into wire. Pick which in its panel.

delta-f1df2afc.text: I won't sugarcoat it: the Moon is falling. Our astronomers give Earth seventeen days.

delta-f5646671.text: Your heart rate is elevated. NILE has billed your health insurer for the excitement.

delta-f7b733a0.text: Set an Assembler to Selene Shell: steel, an explosive and an advanced circuit, one per side. It is slow, so build a few.

delta-f828353a.text: NILE has leased you a small plot for now: the fenced land around the Dispatch Pad. It grows as the cannon does.

nile-1d8b6a18.text: PHASE 2 COMPLETE — Targeting systems online. The Moon has been located. It was where we left it.

nile-57fa3f0f.text: PHASE 3 COMPLETE — The Power Core is humming. So is the Board of Directors.

nile-58fa7a4b.text: PHASE 1 COMPLETE — The cannon foundation has been poured. Earth thanks you. NILE thanks you more.

nile-8335aedf.text: NILE is now NIHIL: the Network for Infrastructure, Heavy Industry & Logistics. Ex nihilo, nihil fit.™

nile-850f7378.text: CORPORATE ANNOUNCEMENT — NILE is thrilled to share that our bold new name will be unveiled upon completion of Protocol: Selene. Stay tuned!

nile-e0c1ccb0.text: INCOMING TRANSMISSION — NILE, Network for Infrastructure, Logistics & Engineering. Office of Planetary Continuity.

nile-e0edb77f.text: Moon+ is now live. Look up! Your complimentary three-day trial has already expired.
